Social Fun Sunday

Sullivan's Island, SC · Road

No-dropBeginner friendly

Social Fun Sunday is a road group ride in Sullivan's Island, SC. It rolls every Sunday at 10:00 am from Harris Teeter, Sullivan's Island. About 22 miles, 14–18 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 14–18 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Social Fun Sunday group ride

The Charleston club's easy Sunday ride. Twenty-two flat miles around Sullivan's Island and Mount Pleasant at 14 to 18 mph, no-drop. All Coastal Cyclists rides are open to non-members who want to try the club.
